input.context: The crew plugin and the loop plugin are co-evolving. The loop plugin calls crew:build which dispatches builders inside dev-team. There is no stable cross-plugin state contract — the loop writes slice-progress.md in its own schema, and crew reads a subset of those fields, but the mapping is implicit. A new SLICE-78 added planDispatch() to dev-team; the loop plugin is expected to import it. How should the cross-plugin contract be stabilised without introducing circular dependencies or requiring synchronised releases?
constraints: No npm publish in CI — operator-triggered only
Must not require loop and crew to release simultaneously when contract changes
TypeScript strict mode in both repos
The contract surface must be discoverable by a new contributor without reading both codebases

expected_output.summary: Declare the cross-plugin contract as a typed interface in a shared location imported by the loop plugin, versioned via semver on the dev-team side. The loop pins a minimum version; breaking changes force a major bump.
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not merge the two repos; does not create a third shared-types package (premature abstraction with only 2 consumers)
failure_modes_named: Loop plugin pins an older interface version — type errors surface at loop CI, not dev-team CI
Contract drift: field added to crew without being added to the loop consumer type
Silent break: loop reads a field renamed in crew without TS errors because it uses unknown cast

dependencies_graphed.planDispatch: exported from scripts/lib/slice-linker/dispatch.mts; loop imports via relative path or npm link
dependencies_graphed.SliceProgressSchema: Zod schema in dev-team; loop validates via same schema at runtime
dependencies_graphed.version_pin: loop package.json dependencies.crew-plugin pinned to ^version where contract was last stable

interfaces_typed.DispatchPhase: exported type from dispatch.mts; must carry stable field names across minor versions
interfaces_typed.SliceWorkflowConfig: YAML-driven; schema validated at load time via Zod; additive changes are backward compatible

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Cross-repo contract test: dev-team ships a JSON schema snapshot of DispatchPhase; loop CI validates its consumer code against the snapshot. No runtime coupling needed.
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: Shared package adds release coordination overhead (premature for 2 consumers). Direct import from dev-team via npm overrides is operationally simpler but makes the contract invisible. Typed snapshot is the middle ground: visible, versioned, no extra package.

notes: Mined from SLICE-78 (FEAT-166) — planDispatch refactor; DEC-022/023 peer-dispatch contract. Seed type: cross_plugin_refactor.
